description: DATEX2 feed Verkeerscentrum Vlaanderen (full version) is a dataset listed in transportdata.be, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by Agentschap Wegen en Verkeer. The DATEX2 feed contains the following traffic information, known by the Flemish traffic centre, on the highways in Flanders: traffic flow, incidents, current road works and special events that effect traffic. Some incidents and some actual road works on regional roads in Flanders are also included in the DATEX2 feed. Coverage: Belgium (see the dataset page for the exact area). The portal lists 1 resource in XML. The data standards named are datex-II. The national access point types are RTTI, SRTI. The portal shows 2024-12-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-transportdata-be-national-access-point.
